newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates drop to 2.50-3.00 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates drop to 2.50-3.00 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar eased further to a low 2.50 to 3.00 percent range on Monday from 3.00 to 4.00 percent on Sunday as weaker demand for dinars weighed down on rates, dealers said.
Dealers say overnight funds continued to drop further on noticeably lower demand with most lenders having surplus funds.
The market's excess liquidity sent rates tumbling last week to a 4.00 percent average from above 8.00 percent the week before.
Rates hovered in a higher 3.00-4.00 percent range on Sunday.
